"""Durable ASCII stdout from the existing export-job CLI; no image call."""
import argparse,hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,file_sha256
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--jobs-file',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--key',required=True);p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args()
jobs=(ROOT/a.jobs_file).resolve();out=(ROOT/a.output).resolve()
assert jobs.is_relative_to((ROOT/'runtime').resolve()) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',a.key)
assert out.parent==(ROOT/'runtime/dispatch-export').resolve() and re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]+(?:\.probe)?\.json',out.name)
assert not out.exists(),'Inspect the existing exact export; never overwrite an uncertain IPC artifact'
expected=next(j for j in read_json(jobs) if j['key']==a.key)
history=read_json(ROOT/expected['journal']);assert history['attempts'][-1]['status']=='prepared' and expected['prompt']==history['attempts'][-1]['prompt']
command=[sys.executable,'-X','utf8',str(ROOT/'mod_nailong/tools/production_queue.py'),'export-job','--jobs-file',str(jobs),'--key',a.key]
r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,timeout=30)
assert r.returncode==0,(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
actual=json.loads(r.stdout.decode('ascii'));assert actual==expected
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
with out.open('xb') as f:f.write(r.stdout)
assert json.loads(out.read_bytes().decode('ascii'))==expected
print(json.dumps({'file':out.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':file_sha256(out),'bytes':out.stat().st_size,'key':a.key,'exact_full_prompt_and_ordered_inputs_preserved':True,'image_calls':0},ensure_ascii=True),flush=True)
